test_case.test_name: Licensed Intel SSMD cpuaccess one-hour max-TDP flow with OC-enabled safety supervision
test_case.purpose: Verify an approved Intel SSMD release can load its compatible CPU access driver and sustain the exact OC-enabled max-TDP flow for one full hour without hang, loss of manageability, unacceptable throttling, thermal/power excursion or hardware error.
required_package: Licensed pinned SSMD archive, checksum/signature, bundled Drivers/ReadMe and exact flowStressTdp Program JSON
Vendor/project CPU, firmware, OS, kernel/header, compiler and module-signing compatibility approval
Approved cpuaccess build/load/unload procedure and explicit decision that bootupdate is out of scope unless separately authorized
Explicit authorization for oc_enable=1 and one-hour max-power maintenance window with OOB watchdog
Project-approved CPU utilization/power/temperature/throttle, RAS/kernel/SEL and responsiveness limits
test_case.test_command: Verify the licensed archive and compatibility matrix; snapshot kernel modules, boot configuration, CPU/firmware identity, logs and idle telemetry. Build cpuaccess.ko against the running kernel headers, preserve build/module metadata and load it exactly once only after approval; verify `/dev/cpuaccess` and permissions. Validate and hash the exact flow JSON, then run `sudo ./ssmd -f flowStressTdp<Program>.json -u oc_enable=1` for the complete 3600-second source duration under an external hard watchdog and independent OS/BMC telemetry, optionally collecting `sudo ./ssmon -p 1 -l 2` and `sudo ./ssmon -p 3 -l 2`. Preserve exit/report/logs, unload the module, restore temporary state and verify post-health.
test_case.expected_result: The approved module builds and loads without compatibility or signature failure, the intended device node appears, and the exact SSMD flow remains active for the full 3600 seconds with the approved CPU-load profile. SSMD completes successfully, the host stays responsive and manageable, all thermal/power/throttle and error measures remain within approved limits, and module/temporary state is restored.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the licensed artifact and exact flow identity, full build/load evidence, complete 3600-second execution, SSMD success/exit data, independent utilization/power/thermal/RAS evidence within approved limits, continuous responsiveness and verified rollback. Missing numeric limits, flow identity, monitoring interval or recovery evidence is INCONCLUSIVE—not PASS; a device node or SSMD success token alone cannot pass.
safety_gate: Confirm package provenance, exact-kernel compatibility, module-signing policy and unload/recovery path before root module load
Require explicit user authorization for oc_enable=1, verified cooling/power headroom, OOB access and hard external watchdog
Do not run bootupdate unless separately approved with boot-recovery plan; default to nonpersistent module state
Abort on limit breach, unexpected throttle/RAS/kernel/SEL event, hang or OOB loss; preserve evidence and never auto-retry
expected_evidence: License/archive checksum, bundled documentation, platform support matrix and exact flow JSON hash
Kernel/header/compiler identity, complete build log and cpuaccess module metadata/signature
Prestate, module-load output, /dev/cpuaccess permissions and exact SSMD command
Full 3600-second SSMD/ssmon output, timestamps/exit and synchronized OS/BMC telemetry
RAS/kernel/SEL delta, module/boot rollback, post-health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On module, thermal, RAS or responsiveness fault, have the external supervisor stop SSMD, preserve all logs/telemetry, regain control through OOB, unload cpuaccess when safe and restore the original module/boot state. If the host is hung, use only the separately approved recovery plan; do not persist the driver, clear evidence or retry automatically.
